actor_staging: Collect the complete current/historical/nested operative Source/API/receipt/content/editor union before ANY reviewer acceptance. Own review author/reviewer roles alone are not excluded; independently operative aliases still are. Exact profile must distinguish these contexts.

causal_ordering.cost_and_Source_boundary: No expanded legacy JSON, extra mutable cache, shared counter, Source implementation or allowance is introduced. Exact future ordering implementation/readset/node/Source cost remains unproved under all existing caps.
causal_ordering.cycle_error: E_CAUSAL_CYCLE for any complete typed directed cycle or failure to establish a global topological order. E_CAUSAL_SELF_OR_FUTURE for a roster containing itself or its own consumers. Equal times, local phase labels or caller ranks never override refusal.
causal_ordering.edge_completeness: If a mandatory operative edge/profile or its trust bootstrap is unmodeled, E_CAUSAL_PROFILE_UNISSUED blocks qualification. A topological numbering of an incomplete subgraph proves nothing about the whole event.
causal_ordering.formal_witness: For N retained vertices, existence of an injective numbering into builtin integers0..N-1 satisfying every typed edge is the DAG criterion. This is a conceptual validation condition, NOT a new wire field or caller-provided attestation. A future implementation must derive/check complete edges within original bounds; no numbering is issued here.
causal_ordering.global_order: A separate strict topological order over exact whole-fact3 vertices of the COMPLETE finite typed operative dependency graph. For each consumer X -> dependency Y, global_order(Y)<global_order(X). No comparison of reused local phase numbers is made across boundaries.
causal_ordering.later_roster_example: R0 precedesE0 precedesF0 precedesC0 precedesA0 precedesR1 precedesE1. Therefore R1(local_phase1)->A0(local_phase5) is permitted by global order when all prior birth/context/profile duties hold. E1/F1/C1/A1 may NOT be inR1 because they bindR1 and are globally later.
causal_ordering.local_phase: The0..6 values in causal_stages are LOCAL construction labels within one event/boundary, not global rank, timestamp or authority. They may repeat at every boundary; stage6 describes transition to a new boundary.
causal_ordering.recorded_birth_not_physical_authority: Global order alone is not birth evidence. Every original recorded birth/observation/time proof remains independently required; missing evidence is E_CAUSAL_BIRTH_UNMODELED and inverted time is E_CAUSAL_CHRONOLOGY. No native/human/physical provenance is inferred.

coverage_rules: Descriptor refs select the complete required earlier subjects, including purpose/profile and all owner/selection/current-vs-prior request context required by the future profile. No caller-provided truncated list or boolean authority.

Full/capsule subject_refs, reviewer, descriptor/roster/context, verdict and counts match exactly. Full check3 list is complete and all passedTrue. Both semantic payloads require complete independent validation.
Capsule.full_proof is a direct complete fact3. It is not an index because full was born after its prior roster.

Adoption author/root flags/verdict and direct full/capsule joins hold. Effective required coverage is all resolved required_subject_refs PLUS exact late_required_subjects=[different_review,full_proof]. All required owner/selection inputs are already included in earlier coverage, never omitted.

Original order/multiplicity or extra-subject semantics cannot be discarded by this normalized coverage list. Future mapping must prove which fields are sets and retain operative ordered lists as such.
Actual independent review events are not coalesced by equal purpose/reviewer/time/values. A separately adopted exact joint-event contract would be needed; none is issued here.
event_identity: One event_key identifies only one descriptor in exact Root_thread/context/event_boundary. Equal subject/value/time bytes or changing a file path do not create another independent review. Event preparation labels are not physical/human authentication.

payload_profile_trust_bootstrap.no_authority_promotion: A profile pin, event_key, Root-labeled payload or reference ordinal does not by itself establish trusted semantics. OverallNOT_READY, all11blockers, all literal-false holds and no-implementation state remain.
payload_profile_trust_bootstrap.no_self_bootstrap: A normalized event cannot establish the prior trust/adoption of the very payload profile used to validate that event. The profile own normalized approval cannot recursively qualify itself.
payload_profile_trust_bootstrap.required_future_decision: A future exact contract must name an independently established PRIOR trust-root/Source/profile/adoption chain and prove every whole-pin link/ordering/field duty under existing caps. No such trust root, bootstrap record, issued profile or approval chain is supplied or adopted here.
payload_profile_trust_bootstrap.required_refusal: Missing, unresolved or recursive profile trust is E_CAUSAL_PROFILE_UNISSUED. If a complete designated edge graph also has a cycle, retain E_CAUSAL_CYCLE; no accepted event can pass either unresolved condition.

primitive_grammar.UTC6_ASCII: Exact valid Gregorian YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffff+00:00 with ASCII digits. Existing SourceUTC7/native100ns domains retain their exact older profile and are never relabeled.
primitive_grammar.actor: Exact pinned publisher006 _actor. Reviewer is canonical nonroot. Existing descendant exclusion semantics remain; an actor recorded only as author/reviewer of a review is not automatically a Source/content author.

check3.evidence: ordinary fully traversed/counted strict JSON value; no executable callback or ignored serialized payload
check3.name: builtin str length1..512, unique in full checks

fact3.bytes: builtin int, not bool,1..2097152 subject to original field-specific smaller cap
fact3.identity: All3 fields plus actual retained body length and SHA. Matching SHA or row ordinal alone is insufficient.
fact3.path: builtin str<=512 using exact unchanged pinned publisher006 _path. No case/path normalization or portable alias substitution.

primitive_grammar.new_wire: Exact builtin UTF8 JSON bytes, no BOM, invalid Unicode/surrogates, duplicate keys, float or nonfinite numbers. Canonical new wire is sorted keys, minified separators, ensure_ascii=False plus one LF. Existing raw inputs remain exact and are not canonicalized.
primitive_grammar.ref_domain: Only type(value)is int, not bool/subclass,0<=value<len(exact_roster.pins). No strings, dict wrappers, floats, coercion or arbitrary resolver. All other integers are ordinary values.
primitive_grammar.strict_tree: All keys/values/scalars/list containers and full visible payloads count under unchanged50000/depth48. Retain existing pinned fixed-data C0/actor-descriptor exceptions only for their exact old subjects; add none for new records.

scope_of_exactness: Only identity root envelopes, prior roster, typed references and direct late-link grammar are proposed. semantic_payload is NOT globally closed; no current event can qualify without its separately reviewed complete field profile. No profile or record instance is issued.

semantic_payload_blocker.mandatory_profile: A future whole-pinned complete per-event profile must enumerate every key/type/old source field/subject slot/actor role/context/purpose/time/birth/consuming duty. Unknown or unmapped fields must refuse. Profile and its Root adoption are not supplied by this proposal. Its trust bootstrap is UNISSUED: neither the event nor the profile own normalized approval may establish prior trust in that same validating profile. A separately established prior trust-root/Source/profile/adoption chain must be specified and reviewed; absent or recursive trust refuses E_CAUSAL_PROFILE_UNISSUED.
semantic_payload_blocker.preservation: All old operative evidence, checks, purpose/input facts, proof extensions and original duties need explicit preservation or declared-new-semantics mapping. This root envelope alone cannot silently replace old subjects fields or accept open extensions.
semantic_payload_blocker.syntax: Builtin dict with builtin string keys and ordinary strict JSON values; visible and wholly charged, never bytes/Base64/JSON text or an ignored extension bag.

whole_record_identity: Each roster, descriptor, full proof, capsule and adoption is a separate raw whole record. event_key/row/subobject/semantic hash is not its portable identity. A portable verification bundle needs all required whole bodies/context/profile; declared path identities remain exact.
